item.text: {"action":"experiment","hypothesis":"A05’s chemistry routing may make the repaired composition representation more useful than it was in the global G05 test by allowing separate extra_trees/raw fits for cu_o and other while retaining broad fallback training for the small fe_anion route. G05 was only 0.0685 K worse than G01 globally, so an exact input-only ablation of A05 is informative and avoids confounding the representation with the mixed models and targets used in C03.","falsification":"The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement if pooled weighted OOF MAE is not at least 0.01 K below A05’s 7.752598770753422 K (that is, below 7.742598770753422 K), or if positive-Tc MAE exceeds the fixed G01 guard of 8.832165507919859 K. Reported-zero and high-Tc changes should be treated as subgroup tradeoffs, not substitutes for both eligibility conditions.","reason":"The required continuation minimum is still pending, and this untried configuration isolates the input representation while preserving every successful routing, estimator, and target choice from A05.
